WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    rm.ordervault,
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM riskandmargin rm
  INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY rm.ordervault, o.timespan
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    SUM(cnt) as total
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY timespan
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(total) as grand_total
  FROM step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    s2.timespan,
    s2.total,
    CAST(s2.total AS REAL) / s3.grand_total as ratio
  FROM step2 s2
  CROSS JOIN step3 s3
  WHERE s3.grand_total IS NOT NULL
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step4
)
SELECT 
  s4.timespan,
  s4.total,
  s4.ratio,
  s4.ratio - s5.avg_ratio as diff_from_avg
FROM step4 s4
CROSS JOIN step5 s5
WHERE s5.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s4.timespan
